rows.screen_or_component: Application UI host, rendering, and input boundary
rows.player_purpose: Presents the world and all interface layers in one native window and decides whether pointer, keyboard, text, wheel, resize, and focus events belong to the GUI or the world.
rows.entry_point: src/main.cpp creates MainWindow; MainWindow::initializeGL loads content/xaml/Main.xaml and creates the Noesis view.
current_data_bindings: Root ViewModel is installed as Main.xaml DataContext
current_commands_actions: Noesis KeyDown, KeyUp, Char, MouseMove, MouseButtonDown, MouseButtonUp, MouseWheel
World camera drag and WASD pan
World left-click selection and right-click cancellation
World wheel zoom or z-level change
rows.keyboard_behavior: Noesis receives KeyDown first and can consume it; printable Char is synthesized only for a narrow 32-255/single-QChar case. Space bypasses Noesis KeyDown and toggles pause. Unconsumed keys use direct switches. Key release is always sent to Noesis and clears WASD state.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: The host is non-modal. GUI ownership is decided per pointer event using a Noesis VisualTree hit test; no global modal input shield was found in MainWindow.
rows.data_update_source: Qt window events; MainWindowRenderer camera/viewport state; queued MainWindow signals to game-thread aggregators; ViewModel window-size/UI-scale slots.
rows.notes_and_risks: Critical parity seam. A world press followed by release over GUI sends a GUI up without a GUI down; a GUI press released over world also sends GUI up. A world-started drag remains a camera drag after crossing GUI. Mouse move still updates the world cursor behind GUI. A world-origin right press released over GUI does not clear m_rightDown in that branch. Logical Noesis coordinates versus device-pixel OpenGL viewport require high-DPI proof. Preserve GUI consumption, 5-pixel drag threshold, click-on-release, right-click, wheel XOR setting, and z bounds.

rows.player_purpose: Switches between title/menu flow and the running-game HUD while applying the global interface scale.
rows.entry_point: content/xaml/Main.xaml, loaded directly by MainWindow::initializeGL.
current_commands_actions: State transitions: Main, Start, Settings, NewGame, LoadGame, Wait, GameRunning, Ingame
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape enters through EventConnector. GameModel gets first chance to close an in-game surface; only a propagated escape reaches ViewModel::OnBack to open or close the pause menu.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Mutually exclusive main-menu and game roots, but child overlays inside GameGui are layered rather than separate native windows.
rows.data_update_source: ViewModel state changes; MainWindow resize divided by UIScale; Settings proxy UI-scale updates.
rows.notes_and_risks: The Start state exists in C++ but no distinct visible Start page was identified. Preserve the escape propagation order and avoid simultaneous interactive roots.

rows.player_purpose: Lets the player continue the newest compatible save, start immediately, configure a new world, load a save, change settings, or exit.
rows.entry_point: ViewModel State::Main displays MainMenu.xaml/MainPage.xaml after startup or returning from a game.
rows.keyboard_behavior: The page sets initial focus to Continue on fade-in. Normal focused-button navigation is handled by Noesis. Escape is routed through ViewModel::OnBack.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen route; non-modal within the menu flow.
rows.data_update_source: ProxyMainView receives version and compatible-save availability; EventConnector starts, continues, or exits through GameManager.
rows.notes_and_risks: The visible immediate New Game action starts with the current settings, while Set up Game opens the editor. Preserve that distinction and newest-compatible-save logic.

rows.player_purpose: Configures world generation, population, starting resources and animals, name, seed, and presets before creating a kingdom.
rows.entry_point: Main menu Set up Game command changes ViewModel to State::NewGame and shows NewGamePage.xaml.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Focused controls use Noesis keyboard behavior; Escape/Back returns to the parent menu route.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen menu route; non-modal.
rows.data_update_source: NewGameModel directly wraps Global::newGameSettings and database-backed preset/item/animal/material catalogs; EventConnector forwards start to GameManager.
rows.notes_and_risks: This is a broad, stateful form with template-driven lists. Migration must preserve numeric ranges, preset side effects, stable IDs, and the exact settings object consumed by game creation.

rows.player_purpose: Finds kingdoms and saves, shows save metadata and compatibility, and resumes a selected or most recent game.
rows.entry_point: Continue on MainPage, Load Game on MainPage, or Load in the pause menu.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Focused list/buttons use Noesis; Escape/Back returns to title or pause-menu parent.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen route. It can be entered from either title or an already-running paused game.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorLoadGame scans save metadata, returns kingdom/save lists through LoadGameProxy, and selected path reaches GameManager::ContinueGame.
rows.notes_and_risks: Compatibility status must remain visible and enforced. Loading from an existing game tears down and reinitializes global/game/aggregator state; UI navigation alone is not sufficient validation.

rows.player_purpose: Changes interface scale, fullscreen, language, camera keyboard speed, minimum light, mouse-wheel behavior, and master volume.
rows.entry_point: Settings from title or pause menu displays SettingsPage.xaml.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Focused controls use Noesis. The Controls tab is a placeholder; configured keybinding catalog is not exposed here.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen menu route; non-modal. There is no Apply/Revert transaction.
rows.data_update_source: Config values are read by AggregatorSettings and persisted as controls change; scale and window effects are relayed to the GUI thread.
rows.notes_and_risks: Potential key/default mismatches exist: bundled config uses GUIScale while code also synthesizes uiscale; default language text does not match en_US/fr_FR options; AudioMasterVolume may be absent. Language choice does not dynamically swap the explicitly merged en_US XAML dictionaries.

rows.player_purpose: Shows that the game is busy during a menu-to-game transition.
rows.entry_point: ViewModel State::Wait displays WaitPage.xaml during start/load processing.
rows.keyboard_behavior: No page-specific command; host-level keys may still arrive unless the route consumes them.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen waiting route, intended to be blocking from the player's perspective.
rows.data_update_source: ViewModel route state around GameManager start/load lifecycle.
rows.notes_and_risks: The current page is static. Replacement should explicitly define whether escape and world input are blocked while game state is being torn down or initialized.

rows.screen_or_component: Pause menu, save, resume, and return-to-title
rows.player_purpose: Pauses or resumes the simulation and offers load, save, settings, and quit-to-menu actions while a game is active.
rows.entry_point: Escape propagates from GameModel to ViewModel, or ViewModel is told to show the menu by GameManager.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape first closes the deepest GameModel surface/build tier/selection; only if none is active does it toggle this menu. Space toggles pause directly at the host.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Full-screen menu root replaces the game GUI and GameManager pauses the simulation; semantically modal over the running game.
rows.data_update_source: ViewModel route and GameManager pause state. Save pauses, performs IO, then restores/resumes according to the prior state.
rows.notes_and_risks: Preserve the two-stage escape contract and pause ownership. Save/load must be validated against actual slot mutation and a subsequent reload, not just button activation.

rows.screen_or_component: In-game HUD, time, watch list, render toggles, and speed controls
rows.player_purpose: Keeps kingdom status, level, date/time, sunlight, watched objects, rendering modes, pause, and simulation speed visible while leaving the map dominant.
rows.entry_point: GameGui.xaml becomes visible when ViewModel ShowGameGUI is true after game initialization.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Space toggles pause before Noesis; H toggles walls; O toggles overlays and Ctrl+O debug mode; comma/period rotate the world; WASD pans. These are direct host switches, not the declared KeyBindings catalog.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal HUD layered over the world. Individual HUD elements consume pointer events only where VisualTree hit testing returns a visual.
rows.data_update_source: Game clock/time and kingdom signals through EventConnector; globals/GameManager for pause and speed; renderer settings; AggregatorInventory watch-list snapshots.
rows.notes_and_risks: Do not let large transparent RmlUi boxes steal map clicks. Watch-list and speed state must update without polling the wrong thread. The declared keybindings.json catalog is currently not wired into MainWindow dispatch.

rows.screen_or_component: Build/designation command tiers and active world selection
rows.player_purpose: Chooses mining, building, farming, stockpile, terrain, job, and other designations, previews an area in the map, rotates placements, and commits or cancels it.
rows.entry_point: Bottom GameGui action buttons select GameModel ButtonSelection and populate first/second-tier commands; map pointer events then reach AggregatorSelection.
current_commands_actions: Choose build type, material, and item
Escape unwind selection then command tiers
rows.keyboard_behavior: R rotates the active selection unless Ctrl invokes the debug OpenGL rotation path. Escape unwinds current selection, then subcommand tiers, before the pause menu. Right-click independently backs/cancels the active selection.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal toolbar plus persistent selection readout; interaction mode captures world clicks only when an active selection action exists.
rows.data_update_source: GameModel command construction; AggregatorInventory build item/material availability; Selection owns action and geometry; AggregatorSelection projects screen coordinates using camera/viewport and emits renderer preview data.
rows.notes_and_risks: Highest gameplay-regression risk. Left-click with no active action opens TileInfo, but with an action it commits selection. Projection searches downward up to 20 levels and Shift forces the visible z-level. Build variants and typed item/material payloads must remain intact. Magic has no subcommands and Plant tree has an empty action in the current source.

rows.screen_or_component: Tile inspector and contextual terrain/object actions
rows.player_purpose: Inspects the selected tile and its terrain, items, creatures, automata, jobs, designations, rooms, mechanisms, and context actions.
rows.entry_point: A world left click with no active selection action causes AggregatorSelection to emit the tile ID to AggregatorTileInfo.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes TileInfo through GameModel::OnCmdBack before the pause menu. World click continues to choose a new tile when not in an active selection mode.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal center overlay. It coexists with the map and routes to other management surfaces.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorTileInfo builds a snapshot from Game/Map/Global managers for the selected tile; tile-update signals refresh it; commands return through EventConnector to jobs/managers.
rows.notes_and_risks: A new tile resets the current tab to All. Agriculture designation UI is embedded here rather than in a separately instantiated GameGui agriculture window. Context commands can mutate the simulation and need state-changing validation.

rows.player_purpose: Shows a selected creature's identity, activity, profession, attributes, needs, and equipped items.
rows.entry_point: Creature command from TileInfo opens CreatureInfo.xaml through GameModel.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the inspector before propagating to the pause menu.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal management overlay over the world.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorCreatureInfo snapshots the selected creature and profession data; relevant manager updates are relayed through the proxy.
rows.notes_and_risks: Equipment is slot-structured and profession changes are mutations, not presentation-only fields.

rows.player_purpose: Creates and manages farms, pastures, and groves, including products, tilled state, animals, seeds, harvest rules, and limits.
rows.entry_point: TileInfo designation/manage flow displays Agriculture.xaml in its ShowDesignation region.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape backs out through the containing TileInfo/GameModel surface.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Embedded non-modal inspector surface; current source also contains a GameModel ShowAgriculture route but GameGui does not instantiate a separate agriculture overlay.
rows.data_update_source: FarmManager, PastureManager, and GroveManager signals feed AggregatorAgri; commands mutate those managers through EventConnector/aggregation paths.
rows.notes_and_risks: Route duplication is ambiguous. Preserve the actually reachable embedded path unless product architecture intentionally changes it; validate each of farm, pasture, and grove separately.

rows.player_purpose: Names a stockpile, filters accepted items, sets priority and limits, suspends it, configures pull behavior, and reviews stocked contents.
rows.entry_point: Manage a stockpile from TileInfo to set GameModel ShownInfo::Stockpile.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the stockpile overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal centered management overlay.
rows.data_update_source: StockpileManager add/content/tick signals and request snapshots feed AggregatorStockpile; commands mutate the selected stockpile.
rows.notes_and_risks: The filter hierarchy is template-driven and identity-sensitive. The XAML close button carries an apparently copied MilitaryWindow parameter, but current close handling ignores it; do not encode the wrong parameter into the new contract.

rows.screen_or_component: Workshop, crafting orders, butcher/fisher, and trader
rows.player_purpose: Inspects a workshop, manages craft orders and priorities, operates special workshop modes, and builds trade offers.
rows.entry_point: Manage a workshop from TileInfo opens WorkshopGui.xaml through GameModel.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the workshop overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal centered management overlay; special workshop submodes are conditional regions of the same surface.
rows.data_update_source: WorkshopManager selected-workshop/job-list updates and inventory/trade data feed AggregatorWorkshop; commands mutate workshop queues and trading state.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: windows/workshop_manager.rml with craft_queue and trade_offer components
rows.notes_and_risks: This combines multiple behavior modes and rich list templates. A visual match without queue reordering, material selection, and real inventory mutation is insufficient.

rows.player_purpose: Reviews citizens and manages their professions, job priorities/skills, and daily schedules.
rows.entry_point: Population button in GameGui sets GameModel ShownInfo::Population.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the population overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal large management overlay.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorPopulation snapshots population/profession/skill/schedule managers on open and returns mutations to those managers.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: windows/population_manager.rml with profession_editor and schedule_editor components
rows.notes_and_risks: Dense editing surface with nested template lists. Validate stable selection when collections refresh and persistence across save/reload.

rows.player_purpose: Browses owned resources by category/filter and compares available stock with totals.
rows.entry_point: Inventory button in GameGui sets GameModel ShownInfo::Inventory.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the inventory overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal large management overlay.
rows.data_update_source: InventoryManager item add/remove events and request snapshots feed AggregatorInventory; the same aggregator supplies build lists and watch data to other UI surfaces.
rows.notes_and_risks: GameGui's visible Inventory button text appears to say Stockpiles. Preserve the actual Inventory route/data contract while correcting player-facing labeling only if approved by the UX architecture.

rows.player_purpose: Creates squads and roles, assigns members, configures uniforms/materials, attitudes and priorities, and controls military organization.
rows.entry_point: Military button in GameGui sets GameModel ShownInfo::Military.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the military overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal large management overlay.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorMilitary snapshots squad/role/population/material data and dispatches all military mutations to the game managers.
rows.notes_and_risks: Large identity-heavy editor. Maintain selected squad/role across refreshes and validate actual member/equipment assignments, not only list updates.

rows.player_purpose: Reviews neighboring kingdoms, their wealth/economy/military/attitude, and creates or manages missions and assigned citizens.
rows.entry_point: Missions button in GameGui sets GameModel ShownInfo::Neighbors.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the neighbors/missions overlay before pause-menu propagation.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal large management overlay.
rows.data_update_source: EventManager mission updates and game neighbor data feed AggregatorNeighbors; mission actions mutate through its queued command path.
rows.notes_and_risks: The GameGui Kingdom command branch is empty while Missions opens this surface. Keep the reachable route distinct from planned kingdom UI.

rows.player_purpose: Presents an event message and accepts OK, Yes, or No responses.
rows.entry_point: Game/event systems signal EventConnector::onEvent, which updates GameModel popup fields and visibility.
rows.keyboard_behavior: No explicit Enter/Escape answer contract was identified; buttons rely on normal Noesis focus behavior.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Semantically modal workflow, but the XAML is a centered 500x300 panel and static inspection did not prove a full-screen hit-test/input shield.
rows.data_update_source: Game/EventManager notification and response callback path through EventConnector.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: modals/event_prompt.rml with explicit modal input blocker
rows.notes_and_risks: Do not assume current layering blocks map clicks outside the panel. The replacement needs an explicit policy for world input, focus ownership, Enter/Escape, and unanswered-event lifecycle.

rows.player_purpose: Lets developers inspect needs/decay and spawn gnomes/items or adjust diagnostic window/data sizes.
rows.entry_point: Debug button in the top-right HUD or Ctrl-modified host shortcuts set GameModel ShownInfo::Debug/debug modes.
rows.keyboard_behavior: Escape closes the debug overlay. Ctrl+O toggles debug mode and Ctrl+R follows a separate debug OpenGL rotation path in MainWindow.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Non-modal developer overlay.
rows.data_update_source: AggregatorDebug reads/mutates debug-facing game data; host direct shortcuts mutate renderer/debug state.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: debug/debug_panel.rml behind an explicit debug availability gate
rows.notes_and_risks: Keep debug-only controls unavailable in release/player paths as intended. Spawning is destructive game mutation and should use disposable validation saves.

rows.screen_or_component: Localization, styles, templates, fonts, icons, and images
rows.player_purpose: Provides all visible labels, reusable control/list presentation, typography, menu scenery, clock art, and command icons.
rows.entry_point: ResourceDictionary merges in Main.xaml and each player-facing XAML document; relative asset URIs resolve below content/xaml.
current_data_bindings: DataTemplates selected by reflected model types
Image URI properties and static image sources
current_commands_actions: No standalone action; these resources support every screen and control template
relevant_proxy_or_aggregator: No runtime localization resource-switch proxy identified
rows.keyboard_behavior: Styles define focus/selection presentation; no centralized keyboard mapping is supplied by the resource dictionaries.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Cross-cutting resource component, not a screen.
rows.data_update_source: Static XAML resources and assets; Strings loads database Translation text during game initialization.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: shared/theme.rcss, shared/localization adapter, shared/components/*.rml, existing converted assets
rows.notes_and_risks: All inspected player XAML explicitly merges localization/en_US.xaml, so the settings language value does not presently switch those dictionaries. Hard-coded English also exists. Preserve font license material. Inventory file contains every resource dictionary, key, template, converter, image reference, and XAML document found.

rows.player_purpose: Intended to map named actions such as global/build commands to configurable keyboard chords.
rows.entry_point: keybindings.json is parsed by src/gui/keybindings.cpp when KeyBindings::update is called.
current_data_bindings: Configured command group/name/key/modifier records; not bound into XAML
current_commands_actions: Declared navigation, global, build and debug action names in keybindings.json
rows.keyboard_behavior: Currently inactive in the inspected upstream path: Global contains a commented m_keyBindings.update(), and MainWindow uses direct Qt key switches rather than getCommand.
rows.modal_or_non_modal_behavior: Cross-cutting input configuration, not a screen.
rows.data_update_source: Static root keybindings.json if initialized; current runtime dispatch appears independent of it.
rows.replacement_rmlui_document_or_component: controllers/CommandRouter plus optional screens/keybindings.rml only after architecture decision
rows.notes_and_risks: Do not infer that every declared JSON action currently works. Preserve the actual direct shortcuts as the compatibility baseline, and treat activation of dormant bindings as a deliberate feature decision rather than migration parity.
